topic: Collection names can read two ways when names contain "__"
detail: Space collections are '<base>__<space>'. The policy's name pattern allows '_' (so 'a__b' is a valid space name) and rag.qdrant.collection and backup_collection are not checked for '__'; only a migration target containing '__' is refused. A backup drop therefore also deletes any collection named '<backup>__<lowercase name>' (another tool's, say), and a hand-set base containing '__' could read as another base's space (DropCollection refuses that case for the active and shadow base). Options: forbid '__' in space names (internal/spaces/validate.go) and in the two collection settings, or keep the list of a base's spaces in orch.db instead of parsing names.
